subject: general
question: PM and PN are two tangents of a circle from an external point P. M and N are points on the circle. If PM = y² - 9 and PN = 55, then what is the value of y?
solution:
Given:

PM and PN are two tangents of a circle from an external point P.

PM = y2 - 9

PN = 55

Concept:

Tangents are equal in length drawn from an outside point on the circle.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/151ed6fc539be108c90761da3d0a48d1d6e4521f54fd698fd075b765ec3d62de.png] 

According to the concept,

PM = PN (Tangents are equal)

y2 - 9 = 55

y2 = 55 + 9 = 64

y = 8

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
